name: Mishimoto Automotive

about:
Mishimoto Automotive was founded in 2005 in Garnet Valley, Pennsylvania, by automotive enthusiasts seeking to build superior cooling system upgrades. The company remains headquartered in a 68,000-square-foot facility that houses its corporate offices, engineering studio, and testing labs.

The company designs and manufactures performance cooling products including aluminum radiators, intercoolers, oil catch cans, silicone body mounts, and liquid-chill systems. All research and development is conducted in-house using a ROMER Arm, Faro 3D laser scanner, rapid-prototyping 3D printers, computational fluid dynamics analysis, and Dynapack and Dynojet all-wheel-drive dynamometers for validation.

Mishimoto serves automotive enthusiasts across sport compacts, powersports, trucks, Jeeps, muscle cars, daily drivers, and classic vehicles. Its products are used in autocross, drag racing, off-road, and towing applications, with documented collaborations such as a Ford Racing Parts intercooler for the Maverick.

The brand differentiates itself with a lifetime warranty that includes accident protection, direct-stock fitment for straightforward installation, and a global infrastructure that includes offices in Sparks, Nevada, London, Shanghai, and Sydney. Military and first-responder discounts are also offered.
